name: Ilus Juutilainen
original_name: イルス ユルティライネン
source:
One of the best soldiers of Scandinavia. She loves flying.
Based on Eino Ilmari "Illu" Juutilainen, a fighter pilot of the Finnish Air Force, and the top scoring non-German fighter pilot of all time.
